messages:
lee_sales: hey team, Kinexa (large B2B support org) wants a 4-6 week pilot. goals: 1) realtime agent-assist (live suggestions + entity extraction) 2) relevance-ranking for KB articles. they also want a firm cost cap for the pilot and clear security guarantees before kickoff. can we sketch use-cases + success metrics today?
omar_se: recommend prioritizing agent-assist first (most customer value). we should ask for a 150-200 prompt eval set and a labeled relevancy sample for ranking (at least 500 pairs).
ravi_eng: technical notes: their support UI sends user text + full convo context. we should implement prefix/KV caching for common flows and incremental streaming to reduce latency. ingestion: PDFs + HTML, many docs are role-restricted. need redaction rules and per-doc ACLs.
claire_security: procurement flagged two blockers: (a) they require a documented data handling flow stating where PII is logged, (b) an option for no retention during pilot. we'll provide retention-off for hosted pilot, but Dedicated or Private required for tenant-only egress guarantees.
tara_success: pricing ask: they want a hard cap of $6k for the pilot. estimate both hosted and Dedicated costs for 1.5M tokens and 100k embedding calls. include overhead for EU/US region egress differences.
omar_se: acceptance criteria draft:
- agent-assist: top-1 suggestion correctness >= 78% on 150 blind prompts
- entity extraction: F1 >= 0.8 on customer-labeled spans
- ranking: NDCG@5 >= 0.72 on provided relevance set
- hallucination: verified false-assertion rate <= 6%
- latency: end-to-end p95 <= 350ms for agent responses
- availability: no more than 1 total minute of downstream failures during pilot per week
- security: retention disabled, audit logs enabled, SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning
ravi_eng: endpoints we'll stand up for pilot (minimal surface):
```
POST /v1/assistant/respond   -> stream suggested reply + trace ids
POST /v1/assistant/extract   -> entity extraction for UI highlights
POST /v1/search/nearest      -> top-k vector hits (k configurable)
POST /v1/search/rerank       -> rerank top-k with context
POST /v1/ingest/upload      -> doc ingestion (pdf/html)
```
deploy_bot: infra: can spin up a 2-GPU Dedicated pool in ~5 business days for EU region. Hosted endpoints available today in US.
claire_security: I've uploaded the security questionnaire they sent: https://drive.redwood.internal/Kinexa_SecQ_v2.xlsx. please review Q12 (PII egress) and Q27 (encryption key control). also attaching SOC2 link: https://redwood.internal/certs/soc2-report.pdf :white_check_mark:
tara_success: quick suggestion for preserving their $6k cap: run A/B with base model for correctness and a cheaper quantized tier for throughput. prioritize cost on the ranking path (batch embeddings + offline rerank) to save tokens.
lee_sales: timeline and blockers (customer side): they can provide eval prompts within 3 business days, but SSO metadata will take their IdP team ~4 days. our blockers: ingestion pipeline work ~6 business days, security clarifications ~2 days if Claire available.
omar_se: eval plan: run blind eval across 150 agent prompts and 500 ranking pairs. compute accuracy/cost per model variant and produce an A/B summary with latency distributions. recommend also a smoke test harness for the UI to validate streaming edges.
claire_security: decision note: if customer insists on VPC egress restriction, we must move to Dedicated or Private before ingesting production KB. mark as gating item.
tara_success: action items:
- @lee_sales: confirm pilot start window and confirm $6k cap acceptance (and whether they'll accept Hosted with retention off)
- @omar_se + @ravi_eng: produce endpoints + quick runbook for integration by EOD tomorrow
- @claire_security: answer Q12 and Q27 in questionnaire and flag any non-starters
- @deploy_bot: please create a Dedicated quote for 2x A100-equivalent GPUs (EU uplift) and a hosted cost estimate for the token/embedding volumes
lee_sales: I'll push to Kinexa and loop back today. thanks all :thumbsup:
